test_batching_decorators: test the batching decorators batch_function and batchable_function with configurable batch sizes and custom batching functions
test_batch_method: test the batch_method decorator for batching class methods with batch_size and custom batching_function parameters
test_batchable_method: test the batchable_method decorator wrapping batched implementations with single-call signatures
test_run_batching: test the run function executing async plans with batching enabled and disabled
test_stream_batching: test the stream function iterating async generators with batching support
test_stream_updates: test the stream_updates function producing intermediate updates and final results from traced async plans
test_safe_stream: test the safe_stream context manager for exception-safe streaming with batching
test_exception_handling: test exception handling in batched functions and methods with and without error catching
test_threadpool_batching: test combining batch_function with run_function_in_threadpool for parallel batch execution
test_threadpool_method_batching: test combining batch_method with run_method_in_threadpool for parallel batch method execution
test_to_thread_pool_method: test the to_thread_pool_method decorator for executing methods in a thread pool
test_context_propagation: test context variable and tracer propagation through batching.run into thread pools and traced coroutines
test_disable_batching: test disabling batching at runtime with enable_batching=False parameter
test_multi_thread_batching: test running batching.run from multiple threads with proper isolation and shared queue behavior
test_batching_with_threadpool_single_dec: test batch_function_with_threadpool combining batching and threadpool in a single decorator
